t: A desktop six-axis industrial robot arm for high school robotics courses.
steps: Find the Mirobot on the WLKATA site and ask for current pricing.
Ask IT to confirm which computers can run WLKATA Studio.
Open the Mirobot Beginner Textbook and follow the first lesson.
Ask WLKATA for its privacy policy. None was found.
Add the AI Vision Set only after the basic moves work.
